label: Todoist Task
description: A task on a Todoist project, captured with upstream fidelity. Mirrors Todoist's Sync API item resource closely so a round-trip preserves what Todoist considers authoritative (content, description, project_id, section_id, parent_id, labels, priority, due, child_order, completed, url, comment_count). For cross-app interop with non-Todoist consumers, the Todoist integration can also be configured to write to `core.task` instead, but the default and the fidelity choice is this type.

description.description: Free-text description attached to the task (maps to Todoist `description`).

project_id.description: Todoist project id the task lives on. Inbox project is the default when this field is unset.

section_id.description: Todoist section id within the project, when the task is grouped under a section.

parent_id.description: Parent task id when this task is a subtask (Todoist allows arbitrary nesting depth).

labels.description: Label names attached to the task (maps to Todoist `labels`). Free-form strings.

priority.description: Task priority (1 = no priority through 4 = urgent, matching Todoist's wire convention).

due.description: Due date/time object. Carries any of `{ date, datetime, string, lang, is_recurring, timezone }`; `null` when the task has no due date.

child_order.description: Stable sort order within the parent (maps to Todoist `child_order`).

completed.description: Mirrors Todoist's `checked` flag. Closing a task in Myme (state transition to trashed) maps to Todoist's `/close` endpoint, which sets this to true upstream.

url.description: Stable HTTPS link to the task on the Todoist web UI.

comment_count.description: Number of comments on the task at last sync (maps to Todoist `comment_count`).
